# phoson-cli reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_cli_reference.py — do not edit by hand. -->

## Command line

Output of `phoson-cli --help`:

```text
phoson-cli [options] [task]

Interactive agent CLI. The default interactive front end is the
full-screen TUI; use --classic for the line-by-line REPL.

One-shot mode (no REPL, no session — for scripts and CI):
  phoson-cli "fix the failing tests"      # positional task
  phoson-cli -p "summarize this repo"     # --print flag
  echo "explain the CI failure" | phoson-cli   # piped stdin

Options:
  -p, --print          Print the final answer and exit (one-shot mode)
  --auto               One-shot: run tools that would ask (programs, code,
                       deletes) instead of refusing them
  --version            Show the version and exit
  --model <id>         Override the model for this run
  --provider <id>      Override the provider for this run
  --theme <tier>       Override the theme: system, dark, light, ansi, no-color
  --max-turns <n>      Override max_iterations for this run
  --session <id>       Resume a saved session by id (prefix match works)
  --resume <id>        Alias for --session
  --name <agent>       Run as a named agent other windows can message
                       (peer_ask / peer_send, /peers, /tell)
  --team <team>        Peer team for --name (default: "default")
  --trace              One-shot only: emit a JSON line per agent event
                       (tool calls, steps, final/error) to stderr
  --classic            Use the classic line-by-line REPL
  --no-fullscreen      Alias for --classic
  --setup              Run the setup wizard
  --self-update        Check for and install CLI updates
  --uninstall          Uninstall phoson-cli
  --install-plugin <source>  Install and enable a community plugin (alias)
  -y, --yes            Skip the confirmations (plugin install/update only)
  plugin <command>     Manage plugins (see `phoson-cli plugin help`):
                       install, uninstall, update, list, info, enable,
                       disable, doctor, config, new, validate
  bg list              List saved sessions with run status (read-only)
  -h, --help           Show this help and exit
```

## Slash commands

Available inside the interactive session (TUI and `--classic`). Plugins
can contribute more; `/help` lists everything active in a session.

| Command | Aliases | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/exit` | `/quit` | Exit the REPL |
| `/new` | `/clear` | Start a new session |
| `/model` | — | Pick or set the active model (all configured providers) |
| `/provider` | — | Pick or set the active provider |
| `/subagent-model` | — | Pick or set the model used by sub-agents |
| `/reasoning-effort` | `/effort` | Show or set reasoning effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, or off |
| `/tree` | — | Show the conversation tree as ASCII |
| `/compact` | — | Compact the conversation (preview + confirm); /compact on\|off toggles auto-compaction |
| `/resume` | — | Resume a saved session by id (prefix match works) |
| `/status` | — | Show provider, model, session, cost, tokens and permissions |
| `/about` | — | Show the Phoson wordmark and about info |
| `/sessions` | — | List, load (#) or pick saved sessions |
| `/delete` | — | Delete a session by id |
| `/label` | — | Label the current node with a short name |
| `/title` | — | Set a human-readable title for this session |
| `/theme` | — | Show, pick or set the color theme: dark, light, ansi, no-color |
| `/keys` | — | List the key bindings (full-screen TUI; [keys] remaps in config.toml) |
| `/undo` | — | Undo the last turn (branch from before your last message) |
| `/attach` | `/attachments` | Attach a file to the next message, or list pending attachments |
| `/help` | — | Show this help |
| `/permissions` | `/perms` | Show or change per-tool permissions: /permissions <tool> <allow\|ask\|deny> |
| `/details` | `/tool-cards` | Tool-call detail: /details [full\|headers\|summary] (bare cycles) |
| `/notify` | — | Notify the terminal when a run finishes: /notify <bell\|desktop\|off> |
| `/warnings` | — | Show or set CLI warning notices: /warnings <on\|off> |
| `/agents-md` | — | Show which AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md memory files are loaded into the prompt |
| `/skills` | — | List available skills, or show one's instructions: /skills <name> |
| `/env` | — | Show provider, model and session info |
| `/cost` | — | Show running cost in USD/credits |
| `/tasks` | — | Background tasks: list, <n> output, cancel/approve/deny <n> |
| `/tokens` | — | Show running input/output token totals |
| `/steps` | — | Show the number of agent steps so far |
| `/auth` | — | Sign in/out of subscription providers (ChatGPT, Google Code Assist) |
| `/setup` | — | Run the initial setup wizard again |
| `/mcp` | — | Manage Model Context Protocol servers |
| `/update` | `/upgrade` | Check for and install CLI updates |
